themes.name: AI-enhanced critical thinking development
themes.definition: Using AI technologies to specifically foster students' critical thinking abilities through structured interventions and pedagogical approaches
evidence: [Favero2025] 'present an innovative educational chatbot designed to foster critical thinking through Socratic questioning'

[Tashtoush2025] 'revealed significant improvements in the mean scores of critical thinking skills among secondary students who were exposed to Artificial Intelligence Techniques (AITs), particularly in deduction, interpretation, inference, and evaluation'

themes.name: AI-integrated pedagogical models
themes.definition: Development of new teaching frameworks that systematically incorporate AI technologies into learning processes
evidence: [Kurniawan2025a] 'Digital Project-Based Blended Learning (DPBBL) framework, augmented with Artificial Intelligence (AI)'

themes.name: Reflective and metacognitive development
themes.definition: Approaches emphasizing self-assessment, thought awareness, and iterative learning improvement
evidence: [Hui2025] 'the cognitive relationship between conversational AI and thinking skills in various learning tasks with complexity and uncertainty levels'
[Yang2025a] 'Generative Artificial Intelligence-Supported Reflective Strategies (GAI-RS) has significant effectiveness in promoting students' conceptual knowledge learning, reflective thinking'

themes.name: Generative AI tool applications
themes.definition: Specific implementations of text/generative AI systems in educational contexts to support learning
evidence: [Hönigsberg2025] 'integrating generative artificial intelligence (GAI), such as ChatGPT, into higher education courses'
[Kim2025] 'Students utilized AI chatbots─such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot'

themes.name: Empirical validation of AI effects
themes.definition: Quantitative assessment of AI-integrated learning outcomes to determine effectiveness
evidence: [Kurniawan2025a] 'pre-test and post-test assessments were conducted to measure the effectiveness of the intervention'
[Tashtoush2025] 'study revealed significant improvements in the mean scores of critical thinking skills'

data.meta_observations: Abstracts show strong focus on critical thinking enhancement. Limited but consistent exploration of specific AI tools. Multiple studies using quasi-experimental designs. Quality notes suggest many papers lack quantitative data sections. Bloom's taxonomy and Socratic frameworks appear recurrently with AI-enhanced learning.
data.grounding_notes: All themes are directly supported by quoted text from the abstracts. No themes were inferred beyond what is explicitly stated. All articles are from the provided closed set.
